note: Wooded loops beside a small lake in the park's east end, east of the Mississippi in northern Minnesota; the nearest sites are about 50 m from the water through forest. Site 1 is laid out with its fire ring and table on the far side of a parked camper. --Claude
summary: DNR spk00259 + ReserveMN 100 read: $24/$34 confirmed; 61 drive-in sites (18 electric, 30 A only, no water hookups), 55-ft limit, 4 pull-throughs, one 22-ft site; showers/flush/dump/hand pump; 2027 season 05-14..10-24. Note's 'lakefront sites on Savanna Lake' is wrong (nearest pads ~40-60 m through forest, .1 mile per ReserveMN); not waterfront kept. Phone added.
flags: Note correction: the old note's 'Campground with lakefront sites on Savanna Lake' and the 'overlooks shimmering lakes' marketing prose are not supported. Savanna Lake is where the DNR places the group camp ('overlooks Savanna Lake'); the drive-in campground sits by a smaller lake to its NE. ReserveMN gives every drive-in site '.1 mile' or '.2 mile' (one, 'Snow', 160 ft) to water, and on imagery the nearest pads (45 at ~46.8270,-93.1505; 43, 41; 27 at ~46.8260,-93.1490) are ~40-60 m from the shore through continuous forest. Not waterfront kept.
Rig wording: DNR says 'many sites will not accommodate large/tall rigs'; ReserveMN shows 53 drive-in sites at 25 ft or longer, so a 23-ft rig fits most. Kept, caveat in the sites note.
Pin 46.8264,-93.1515 is ~60 m from the unit centroid (46.82639,-93.15072); no move.
Alerts: park closed to all but licensed hunters November 28 - December 6 (muzzleloader hunt); Shumway Lake Trail boardwalk closed.
